Asia Minor noun

also Anatolia

late Latin

Oros. 1.2.25 (M-O s.v. Asia Minor)

Asia Minor, Asiae Minōris f.

A country takes a preposition: in Asiam Minōrem, in Asiā Minōre, ex Asiā Minōre. The phrase is Orosius’s; classical writers say simply Asia (Lewis & Short s.v. Asia, citing Cic. Imp. Pomp. 6).

Other words

  • Asia, Asiae f. — the Roman province of Asia, in the west of Asia Minor

    noun, first declension · classical · M-O s.v. Asia Minor (Cic.; Verg.; Sen.)

    In Cicero Asia is usually the province; the adjective Asiānus belongs to it (Lewis & Short).

Examples

  • ad clārās Asiae volēmus urbēs

    let us fly to the famous cities of AsiaCatull. 46.6

See also Asia, Ephesus, Smyrna, Troy, Constantinople.
